## Page models

- **light**: white paper, text inks #000000 and #333333.
- **sepia**: the page is multiplied by #f4ecd8.
- **dark-dimmed**: the page at `brightness(0.8)`.
- **dark-inverted**: the page at `invert(0.9) hue-rotate(180deg)`.
